executiveSummary: Recent technology news highlights AI/ML developments, hardware releases, and industry shifts, with Apple leading the charge in iOS 27 and macOS 27 updates, while OpenAI and NVIDIA discuss AI slowdowns and new products. Industry leaders weigh in on AI safety and climate pollution, with Apple challenging a contempt ruling in its Epic case.

takeaways.title: AI slowdown
takeaways.description: Elon Musk and Sam Altman discuss slowing down AI development, while Jensen Huang disagrees. This matters to engineers as it impacts the future of AI and ML technologies.

takeaways.title: Apple updates
takeaways.description: iOS 27 and macOS 27 bring new features, including Siri AI and Apple Intelligence, with over 100 security fixes. This matters to engineers as it impacts device security and user experience.

takeaways.title: Industry shifts
takeaways.description: The Environmental Protection Agency announces plans to kill power plant climate pollution rules, while Trump throws out the rules. This matters to engineers as it impacts the sustainability of technology products.

worthWatching: OpenAI's acquisition of Glass Imaging for $300 million
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's disagreement with Elon Musk on AI slowdowns
engineeringPerspective: The use of Apple Intelligence in HomeKit cameras, which requires a $9.99 iCloud+ plan
The integration of Siri AI in Gentler Stories' exercise-tracking apps, which uses new Siri AI capabilities
